_comment: Downloadable resources hosted on Google Drive (folder: 11edxdHOJOP3JguyvK71cwWg25zsbPP9q). Full folder mirrored as of 2026-08-19 — the three previously withheld titles (NeoFax, Frank Shann Drug Doses, NRP 9th Edition) are now included at Sunil's explicit instruction.

resources.title: WHO & IAP Growth Charts PDF
resources.primaryKeyword: WHO IAP Growth Chart PDF Download
secondaryKeywords: height for age Z score chart
resources.description: Combined 63-page reference of WHO growth standard charts (boys & girls, 0-19 years, weight/height/BMI-for-age, Z-scores) alongside IAP references, in one printable PDF.

resources.title: Fenton 2025 Growth Chart PDF (Boys)
resources.primaryKeyword: Fenton Growth Chart PDF Download Boys
resources.description: Printable Fenton preterm growth chart for boys, 22-50 weeks postmenstrual age.

resources.title: Fenton 2025 Growth Chart PDF (Girls)
resources.primaryKeyword: Fenton Growth Chart PDF Download Girls
resources.description: Printable Fenton preterm growth chart for girls, 22-50 weeks postmenstrual age.

resources.title: AAP 2017 Pediatric BP Chart PDF
resources.description: AAP 2017 pediatric blood pressure tables (Table 4) — BP percentile by age, sex and height percentile, from Pediatrics Vol. 140.

resources.title: Zubrow Neonatal BP Chart PDF
resources.description: Blood pressure values by gestational age at birth (Day 1) — systolic, diastolic and mean pressure by percentile, in the Zubrow nomogram format.

resources.title: AAP 2022 Jaundice Guideline PDF
resources.description: The AAP 2022 clinical practice guideline for hyperbilirubinemia management in newborns ≥35 weeks gestation.

resources.title: NICE CG98 Preterm Jaundice Charts PDF
resources.primaryKeyword: NICE CG98 Jaundice Chart PDF Download
resources.description: NICE clinical guideline 98 (2010) — neonatal jaundice treatment threshold graphs for preterm infants, 23-38+ weeks gestation.

resources.title: Modified Ballard Score Sheet PDF
resources.description: Printable New Ballard Score sheet — neuromuscular and physical maturity signs for gestational age assessment.

resources.title: CAN Score Sheet PDF
secondaryKeywords: Clinical Assessment of Nutrition score sheet
resources.description: Clinical Assessment of Nutritional status (CAN) score sheet for evaluating fetal malnutrition at birth.

resources.title: Thompson HIE Scoring PDF
resources.description: Thompson scoring system reference for grading the severity of hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy in newborns.

resources.title: Sarnat and Sarnat HIE Staging PDF
resources.description: Sarnat and Sarnat clinical staging reference for hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (mild/moderate/severe).

resources.title: POFRAS Score Sheet PDF
secondaryKeywords: Premature Oral Feeding Readiness Scale PDF
resources.description: The Premature Oral Feeding Readiness Assessment Scale (POFRAS) — Fujinaga et al. — for assessing a preterm infant's readiness for oral feeds.

resources.title: LATCH Breastfeeding Score Sheet PDF
resources.description: The LATCH breastfeeding assessment score sheet for evaluating latch, audible swallowing, nipple type, comfort and hold.

resources.title: NICHD HIE / TIMEBRAIN Assessment PDF
resources.description: NICHD-based encephalopathy risk and cooling-eligibility assessment reference (TIMEBRAIN, May 2020) — Apgar, resuscitation duration and acidosis criteria.

resources.title: HINE, HNNE & Newborn Neuro Exam PDF
resources.filename: HINE , HNNE , CNS examination , Neurological assessment of newborns.pdf
resources.primaryKeyword: HINE HNNE Neuro Exam PDF Download
resources.description: 47-page reference covering HINE, HNNE, CNS examination and structured neurological assessment of newborns.

resources.title: Cranial USG Reference PDF
resources.description: 68-page reference guide to cranial ultrasound imaging in the neonate.

resources.title: IAP & NIS Vaccination Schedule PDF
resources.primaryKeyword: IAP NIS Vaccination Schedule PDF Download
resources.description: Combined IAP + National Immunization Schedule (NIS) reference — vaccine, dose, route and age, in table form.

resources.title: IAP Immunisation Schedule 2022 (Print) PDF
resources.description: IAP Immunisation Schedule 2022 formatted for printing — vaccine, dose, and brands available by age.

resources.title: Targeted Neonatal Echocardiography Manual PDF
resources.description: 80-page teaching manual on targeted neonatal echocardiography (TnECHO) technique and interpretation.

resources.title: Nursing & Echo Reference PDF
resources.primaryKeyword: NICU Nursing Echo Reference PDF Download
resources.description: 41-page compiled nursing and echocardiography reference notes for NICU practice.

resources.title: Mechanical Ventilation Manual PDF
resources.primaryKeyword: Neonatal Mechanical Ventilation Manual PDF Download
resources.description: 99-page manual covering the basics of mechanical ventilation in the NICU setting.

resources.title: Neonatal Ventilation Basics PDF
resources.description: A neonatal ventilation basics guideline (Neonatal Guidelines Group), covering core mechanical ventilation concepts.

resources.title: NNF Ready Reckoner PDF
resources.description: Quick-reference tables including ROP screening schedules and other bedside NICU reckoners.

resources.title: IAP Standard Treatment Guidelines — Combined PDF
resources.filename: COMBINED PDF STANDARD TREATMENT GUIDELINE UPTO 093.pdf
resources.primaryKeyword: IAP Standard Treatment Guidelines PDF Download
resources.description: 601-page combined single-PDF edition of the IAP Standard Treatment Guideline chapters — the same content browsable chapter-by-chapter on PediAid's STG site, bundled for one-shot offline download.

resources.title: Acute Neonate Case Proforma PDF
resources.primaryKeyword: Neonatal Case Presentation Proforma PDF Download
resources.description: A structured 79-page case-presentation framework for acute neonates on respiratory support (ventilator/HFOV/CPAP/HFNC) — history, examination, diagnosis and plan, with presentation tips, for exam and ward-round preparation.

resources.title: Growing Preterm Case Proforma PDF
resources.primaryKeyword: Growing Preterm Case Proforma PDF Download
resources.description: A fill-in-the-blank case-presentation template for a growing preterm infant — antenatal history through systemic examination, structured for trainee case presentations.

resources.title: Nutritional Audit in Preterm Babies (Spreadsheet)
resources.description: A working spreadsheet tool for auditing enteral nutrition intake in preterm babies.

resources.title: BLS & Choking Algorithms
resources.description: Basic life support and choking-relief algorithms for infants and children, set out as step-by-step flow charts. Covers the compression-to-ventilation ratios for one and two rescuers, back blows and chest thrusts in the infant, and abdominal thrusts in the older child.
resources.primaryKeyword: Paediatric BLS and Choking Algorithm PDF

resources.title: NRP 9th Edition Manual
resources.description: The Neonatal Resuscitation Program manual, 9th edition — the delivery-room algorithm, positive-pressure ventilation and the MR SOPA corrective steps, airway management, chest compressions and medication in the newborn.

resources.title: PALS Algorithms 2020
resources.description: The 2020 Pediatric Advanced Life Support algorithm set — cardiac arrest, bradycardia and tachycardia with a pulse, shock and post-resuscitation care — in the single-page flow-chart form used for teaching and recertification.

resources.title: NeoFax (Nov 2024)
resources.description: A neonatal drug dosing reference, November 2024 edition, giving dose, interval, route, dilution and administration notes for medicines used in the NICU.

resources.title: Frank Shann Drug Doses (2017)
resources.description: Frank Shann's Drug Doses, 2017 edition — the compact paediatric and neonatal dosing booklet, listing per-kilogram doses for several hundred drugs in one alphabetical table.

resources.title: Immunisation in Special Situations
resources.description: Immunisation in special situations — vaccinating the preterm infant, the immunocompromised or asplenic child, children on steroids or chemotherapy, and catch-up after an interrupted schedule.

resources.title: Paediatric Nutrition
resources.description: Paediatric nutrition notes covering energy and protein requirements by age, assessment of nutritional status, feeding the malnourished child and the common micronutrient deficiencies.

resources.title: Nutritive Value of Common Foods
resources.description: Nutritive value of common foods — energy, protein, fat and key micronutrient content by household measure, for dietary counselling and for checking a child's actual intake against requirement.

resources.title: Cerebral Palsy Case Presentation
resources.description: Case presentation notes for cerebral palsy: structuring the history, the neurological examination, classification by type and topography, the associated impairments to screen for, and the usual discussion points.

resources.title: Paediatric Case Format
resources.description: A blank paediatric case-presentation format — history, birth and developmental history, immunisation, nutrition, examination and summary — in the order expected in clinical postings and examinations.

resources.title: Social Paediatrics
resources.description: Social paediatrics notes: the determinants of child health, growth monitoring and the under-five clinic, child labour and abuse, disability, and the social factors that shape outcomes alongside the clinical ones.

resources.title: National Health Programmes — Brief Notes
resources.filename: BRIEF NOTES ON NATIONAL HEALTH PROGRAMS.pdf
resources.description: Brief notes on the national health programmes relevant to child health, with the objectives, components and target groups of each set out compactly for revision.
resources.primaryKeyword: National Health Programmes Child Health Notes

resources.title: Sankalan — National Health Programmes Handbook
resources.description: The Sankalan handbook of national health programmes — a consolidated reference to the programmes, their objectives, target groups, service components and monitoring indicators in one document.

resources.title: NNF Fellowship Question Bank (to 2026)
resources.description: NNF fellowship question bank covering papers up to 2026, collected by year — useful for seeing which neonatology topics recur and how questions are phrased.

resources.title: MD Paediatrics Question Paper Compilation
resources.description: A compilation of MD Paediatrics university question papers, grouped so the themes that recur across years are visible at a glance.

resources.title: System-wise Question Bank
resources.description: A system-wise paediatric question bank — questions sorted by organ system rather than by year, so one topic can be revised end to end before moving on.

resources.title: Instruments Viva
resources.description: Instruments viva deck covering the paediatric and neonatal instruments laid out in a practical examination, each with its identification, parts, uses, sizes and complications.

resources.title: Instruments Reference
resources.description: An instruments reference for paediatric practical examinations — identification, indication, sizing and the standard follow-up questions for each instrument.

resources.title: Final Year X-Ray Viva
resources.description: Final-year X-ray viva deck: the chest and abdominal radiographs that recur in undergraduate paediatric practicals, with the findings to describe and the diagnosis each points to.

resources.title: X-Ray Viva — PG
resources.description: Postgraduate paediatric X-ray viva deck — radiographs pitched at MD and DNB level, with systematic description, differential diagnosis and the discussion each film is meant to open.
